title: Umphefumulo Obekezelayo Wendlu Engcwele
intro: Emakhasini e-Quran, kuvela umuntu ozalweni lomprofethi omkhulu, onikezwe njengesipho sokuguga. Lo mphefumulo udunyiswa ngokuba neqiniso elingaguquki kanye nendima ebalulekile ekumiseni indawo engcwele eyayizoba isibani sokholo. Njengoba ufunda izinkomba, lalela ngokucophelela izwi elivela esikhathini esidlule, ngoba likhuluma kumuntu wokuqala.
clues: Kukhulunywa ngami ku-Quran kanye nomunye umprofethi njengesipho esinikezwe isithunywa esikhulile.
Ngangingomunye wabantwana ababili abanikwa lowo mprofethi eminyakeni yakhe yokugcina.
Ngidunyiswa yiQuran ngokuba qotho ezwini lami.
Ngahlanganyela nobaba ekuphakamiseni izisekelo zeNdlu Engcwele.
Ngikhunjulwa njengomunye wabanesineke, futhi indlu engcwele esayakha yaba yindawo yokubuyela nokuvikeleka kwabantu.
arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
